module.name: Gallery
module.purpose: Visual and structural trace collection capturing core Triadic scroll behaviors — drift, echo, pulse, ring, and seed — in primary and second-order forms, serving as diagnostic references, remix lineage anchors, and curriculum demonstration artifacts.

files.purpose: Navigation index for the Gallery module — describes the scroll trace collection, file manifest, and diagnostic purpose across five behavior families.
Primary drift trace capturing baseline drift pattern — temporal decay, regime departure signals, and structural divergence under minimal perturbation.
Second-order drift trace capturing drift evolution — compounding divergence, cascade acceleration, and recursive departure from coherence anchors.
Baseline echo trace capturing recursive coherence signals — structural repetition, harmonic reinforcement, and resonance persistence across scroll cycles.
Amplified echo trace capturing second-order recursion — intensified harmonic feedback, deep coherence layering, and multi-cycle resonance amplification.
Core pulse trace capturing regime heartbeat — rhythmic energy output, phase-locked oscillation, and operational tempo under steady-state conditions.
High-intensity pulse trace capturing second-order regime dynamics — elevated amplitude, compressed oscillation periods, and stress-driven tempo shifts.
Primary ring trace capturing dimensional boundary dynamics — envelope containment, radial symmetry, and structural closure across dimensional layers.
Second-order ring trace capturing expanded dimensional closure — nested envelope interactions, inter-ring coupling, and multi-layer boundary resonance.
Foundational seed trace — origin-point signature encoding the initial conditions from which all scroll behaviors emerge and differentiate.
